blocks.text: Tourism ambassador SB19 has been tapped to sing “Together in Motion,” the official theme song for the 2026 Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, which will be hosted by the Philippines. The P-pop supergroup performed the track composed by Anya Lagman and arranged by Jimmy Antiporda and Louie Ocampo.
